notes.title: Kitten Burst v3.02
notes.content:
Patch v3.02 is out now with so many changes the patch notes need sections. Thank you to everyone for your feedback and bug reports! (If you submitted one and don't see it fixed yet, don't worry it's still on my list of things to work on)

BTW Today's the last day you can get Kitten Burst with the early bird discount
 
[b]========================  
   Kitten Burst v3.02
========================      [/b]

[b]Balance[/b]
--------
-Crash avoidance tweaks
-Keys now are rewarded every 40ION instead of every 30ION
-Added Keys to Planet eClips

[b]Gameplay[/b]
--------
-Fixed Vapor state in Bossfights
-Added a device you can use to switch LL back to night after beating the level.
-No roll correct now has dampening so you don't keep spinning (actually feels really fun to play with it off)
-Increased the angular dampening of cat physics when you ragdoll so you don't spin super fast.
-Quick retry in races was keeping spin momentum, should reset you to 0 correctly now
-Quick restarting while moving through Vapor state started the race wherever you landed. While cool, it would make every race need a setup step for speedruners which would get annoying, so I've patched it.
-No more meowing or switching states in cutscenes
-Disabled player movement/boosting in the fishing minigame in FAQ
-Stopped Physics objects from colliding with hyperlink when hyperlinking (going to FAQ)
-Hapi could sit on hyperlinks then travel while still sitting. Now Hapi is not allowed to be this lazy
-Move one of the nodes in Cycle away from wall to hopefully prevent it spawning behind the wall for some reason.
-Optimized particles in ending sequence
-Fix LED scale of some screens
-Fixed one screen not being smashable

[b]UI[/b]
--------
-Cyberspace Atlas Icon now shows it's name
-Dying after pwning the bossfight would bug the UI, now bossfights ignore hits after pwning/dnf 

[b]Dialogue[/b]
--------
-Typos
-Post ??? Quest dialogue only plays once now
-Fix Sonar and Display tutorial hint for keyboard. They showed as Q & E, but they're actually X & H.
-Stop Anchor cutscenes in LL from triggering over and over if you keep talking to guild leaders.

[b]Achievements[/b]
--------
-Older saves with endless records, that were above 4, but didn't get the achievement (when it was 6) seem to be prevented from getting the achievement. Now they will be checked when you go back to the hub.
-Keys achievement now requires you to collect 20 keys in the world, not counting the ones you get as a reward for collecting ION energy.

notes.title: Part C: Development Update
notes.content:
Part C Development Update
---

Hey! It's been a while since Part B: launched in April so I wanted to give an update. I've been hard at work at finishing the last part of Kitten Burst and I'm gearing up for the full release of the game.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40307327/75679b165c166405ead125322b9ebffa0bbd3024.png[/img]

Originally when I launched Part A: in Early Access in September 2022, I estimated Part B and C to both take 6 months of development time. Part B actually took 8 months to develop. I'm currently halfway into development of Part C, which is looking like it will take 10 months.

My new expected release date of Kitten Burst is Jan 2024. I know delays are disappointing, but the game will be better if I take the time to finish it properly. I want to make sure I have plenty of time to Playtest, QA, and Balance the game before release.

Here's what I've been working on:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40307327/4b44c0896f98f346a57426b3f3675ddd7364ef19.png[/img]

I've completely redesigned the opening race/cinematic of the game with a new environment, more cats to fly against, and a more intense race path.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40307327/a85fda49fa59d5a753c23c8909dc532bc7f70b41.png[/img]

I've also finished work on the largest level in the game. It's an MMORPG server called "The Lost Loch". Here you'll uncover the origins of the hacker group SHIVER!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40307327/f3042438f0f6fc667fa932b83b435aa27a750ce8.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40307327/037886037032faa2207ae5ba09ac957edc99ea11.jpg[/img]

This level has 2 new bossfights which I'll keep secret for now.

Here's what's left to work on (keeping it vague so no spoilers):

-A cinematic 
-The final level of the game
-The final boss of the game
-The ending sequence

I've already started pre-production on all of these. You can join the Discord or follow me on Twitter for updates! I also want to make more YouTube Devlog videos in the next couple of months!

That's all for now. Thank you for all of your support! 

TTYL

notes.title: Kitten Burst - Part [A:] - September 2nd, 2022
notes.content:
I’ve been working on this project since April 2020, 2 and a bit years later the first act of Kitten Burst is finished!

The game will launch on PC in Early Access for $25. 

Just to be clear if you pay for the game in early access you will get the full game as it releases. Your feedback & support will help me develop the rest of the game.

If you want to wait for the full release that’s cool too. Even if the game sells 0 copies I’m still going to finish it, because I love making it.

Kitten Burst - Part [A:]
September 2nd, 2022

Kitten Burst - Part [B:]
ETA: Winter 2022/2023

Kitten Burst - Part [C:]
ETA: Summer 2023

I have a solid plan to hit these ETAs ( I’m already well into development for part [B:] ! ) but I’m also not going to crunch myself. If delays come up I’ll let you know and explain why.

Also please be patient with any bugs. The best way to get it resolved is to send some info on the Kitten Burst Forums discord. I’ll try to support everything the best I can, but this is mostly a solo project. 

I say solo, but the game also features work from amazing artists, It was tested and polished from a bunch of really helpful people giving feedback, and wouldn’t have even started without my sister Sophie who helped with character design and building out the lore.
